queries.sql: WITH hist AS (SELECT x->>'caller' caller FROM public.lf_eventos l,jsonb_array_elements(l.payload->'sql_callers') x WHERE l.id=20161), cur AS (SELECT n.nspname||'.'||p.proname fullname,p.proname FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN('programacion','public','lf_ops') AND p.proname ~ '(input_governance|input_readiness|guard_input)') SELECT count(*) total,count(*) FILTER(WHERE h.caller IS NOT NULL) hist,count(*) FILTER(WHERE h.caller IS NULL) complement,count(*) FILTER(WHERE h.caller IS NULL AND c.proname ~ '(queue|direct_step|handoff|continuation|_ctx|cached_v2)') path_candidates FROM cur c LEFT JOIN hist h ON h.caller=c.fullname;
